props.statement: In the process of manufacturing methanol by the interaction of carbon monoxide and hydrogen in the presence of a catalyst capable of causing its formation, the step of completely excluding iron from the reaction.

props.name: patent claim 2

evidence.quote: 2. The process of manufacturing methanol by the interaction of carbon monoxid and hydrogen in the presence of a catalyst ca-. pable of causing the formation of methanol
employing a catalyst, which is free from iron and a non-ferrous inner wall of the contact space and a gas mixture which is completely free from either suspended or

props.statement: The process of manufacturing methanol from carbon monoxide and hydrogen over a catalyst capable of forming methanol, employing a catalyst free from iron, a non-ferrous inner wall of the contact space and a gas mixture completely free from suspended or vaporized iron.

props.name: patent claim 3

evidence.quote: said interaction and at a pressure of more than 50 atmospheres and a temperature of between about 250 degrees and 600 degrees centigrade which consists in employing a catalyst which is free from iron

props.statement: The process of claim 2 carried out at a pressure of more than 50 atmospheres and a temperature between about 250 and 600 degrees centigrade, employing an iron-free catalyst, a non-ferrous inner wall of the contact space and a gas mixture completely free from suspended or vaporized iron.

props.name: contact masses may vary widely

evidence.quote: Provided the above conditions be observed, the other conditions may be varied within very wide limits.
The nature of the contact masses may vary very considerably and the said masses may contain either metals or oxids or mixtures of more than one metal

props.statement: Provided iron is excluded, the other conditions may vary within very wide limits; the contact masses may contain metals or oxides or mixtures of more than one metal, more than one oxide, or of metals and oxides.

props.name: inert gases may be present

evidence.quote: In addition to carbon monoxid and hydrogen, other inert gases may be present

props.statement: Other inert gases may be present in addition to carbon monoxide and hydrogen.

props.name: iron must be kept out of the contact space

evidence.quote: We have now found that methanol can be obtained by the interaction of carbon

evidence.note: the stray '2' is a truncated line number (25) of the patent's margin
evidence.quote: provided the interior 2 of the contact space be kept completely free from iron.
In order to carry out this in vention, the contact masses must be free from iron, the inner surface of the walls of the reaction chamber must not consist of iron and the gases must not carry any iron
either in the form of fine particles or of volatile compounds of iron such as iron carbonyl.

props.statement: Methanol can be obtained from carbon monoxide and hydrogen at elevated temperature and pressure with contact masses capable of forming methanol and higher alcohols, provided the interior of the contact space is kept completely free from iron: the contact masses must be free from iron, the inner walls of the reaction chamber must not consist of iron, and the gases must not carry iron as fine particles or volatile compounds such as iron carbonyl.

props.name: metals with a promoter oxide or salt

evidence.quote: or metals such as copper, silver, lead, zinc in con junction with a metal oxid or a metal salt acting as a promoter especially derived from a metal belonging to the fourth to the seventh groups of the periodic system

props.statement: Metals such as copper, silver, lead or zinc may be employed in conjunction with a metal oxide or metal salt acting as a promoter, especially one derived from a metal of the fourth to seventh groups of the periodic system.

props.statement: The pressure is preferably from 50 atmospheres upwards and the temperature between about 250 and 600 degrees centigrade, depending on the efficiency of the contact mass in each case.
